name: Married... with Children
description: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He hates his job, his wife is lazy, his son is dysfunctional (especially with women), and his daughter is dim-witted and promiscuous.

videos.title: Original Pilot
videos.overview: The original pilot was taped on December 12, 1986. The producers were not happy with the original child actors Tina Caspary (as Kelly) and Hunter Carson (as Bud). They recast the roles and all the scenes with the Bundy kids had to be reshot.

videos.title: Backstage with the Bundys
videos.overview: This half-hour special aired on MTV.  It documented the making of the episode "The Good-Bye Girl" (622).

videos.title: The Best O' Bundy
videos.overview: In the 200th episode, clips of past episodes are shown. This episode is hosted by George Plimpton and you get to see the Married... with Children set as just a Hollywood set and not the Bundy household.

videos.title: My Favorite Married...
videos.overview: The cast discuss their favorite episodes which we see through clips.

videos.title: The Al Bundy Sports Spectacular
videos.overview: Roy Firestone hosts a clip show where we see clips of sports moments from the show.

videos.title: A Day in the Life
videos.overview: We follow Ted McGinley and Amanda Bearse around during one day and see them train, eat, and more. We see Amanda Bearse direct episodes, we see Ted McGinley visit a centre for kids with cancer... and stuff other stuff. We see them working with episode 720 - "Unalful Entry".

videos.title: Reunion Special
videos.overview: Married... with Children had been off the air for six years but now, original cast members Ed O'Neill, Katey Sagal, David Garrison, Amanda Bearse, Christina Applegate, David Faustino and Ted McGinley reunite in the set of the Bundy's home and share memories from working on the show.

videos.title: Married... with Children 2012 Reunion
videos.overview: Fox's 25th Anniversary Special.

videos.title: Bud speaking
videos.overview: David Faustino remembers Married... with Children.

videos.title: Peggy speaking
videos.overview: Katey Sagal remembers Married... with Children.

videos.title: Best of Married... with Children - (All Seasons)
videos.overview: Compilation of all of the best moments of the show.

videos.title: Where Is The Cast of Married... with Children Now?
videos.overview: Special answering the question of "Where Is The Cast of Married... with Children Now?"

videos.title: The Wide World of Bundy
videos.overview: Roy Firestone hosts a clip show where we see clips of sports moments from the show.

videos.title: I'll See You in Court
videos.overview: Al and Peg learn they have been video taped getting intimate at a sleazy motel. The same thing has also happened to Steve and Marcy. They decide to take the matter to court.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: In this pilot we meet Al and Peg Bundy, a very dysfunctional Chicago family. In the pilot, Al and Peg, who have no friends, meet their new neighbors Steve and Marcy Rhoades. Steve and Marcy are a very happily married couple until they learn from the Bundys.

videos.title: Thinnergy
videos.overview: Marcy gives Peggy the book "Thinnergy", which is a book about health. Very inspired by the book, Peggy goes on a diet and tries to convince the family to join in, but they refuse.   When the diet makes Peggy really annoying, Steve convinces Al to join the diet, and persuades Peggy to quit.

videos.title: But I Didn't Shoot the Deputy
videos.overview: The Bundys and the Rhoades' hear of crime in the neighborhood. Al buys a gun, and the Rhoades' buy a dog. Al hears a noise and accidentally kills the dog, thinking it was a burglar.

videos.title: Whose Room Is It Anyway
videos.overview: Steve and Marcy plan on adding another room to their house with their tax refund. Al tries to coax Steve into building a pool room, while Peg and Marcy decide on an exercise room. Who will win?

videos.title: Have You Driven a Ford Lately?
videos.overview: Al and Steve draw closer together when they try to restore a 1965 Mustang. Peg and Marcy on the other hand can't stop from despising their husbands.

videos.title: Sixteen Years and What Do You Get?
videos.overview: Al is unable to purchase a gift for Peg on their 16th wedding anniversary as his credit card seemed to be maxed out.

videos.title: Married... Without Children
videos.overview: In an attempt to spice up their marriage, Al and Peg check in at a hotel, while Steve and Marcy babysit Bud and Kelly. The Rhoades' learn that babysitting the young Bundys is a mistake when the kids turn their home into a rioting party.

videos.title: The Poker Game
videos.overview: Al invites Steve to play poker, but Steve ends up losing his paycheck to Al. Afraid to tell Marcy the truth, Steve tries to convince Peggy to give him the check back.

videos.title: Peggy Sue Got Work
videos.overview: Peg wants a VCR and Al won't get it for her. She ends up working at a department store for money, which disrupts her and Al's relationship.

videos.title: Al Loses His Cherry
videos.overview: Al spends some time at Luke Ventura's apartment after running out from a fight with Peg.

videos.title: Nightmare on Al's Street
videos.overview: Steve is away on business and Marcy is having sexual fantasies with Al involuntarily. Marcy becomes so disgusted and she tells Peg, who tries to give her tips on how to avoid them.

videos.title: Where's the Boss?
videos.overview: After thinking that his boss is dead, Al tries to find another job unless he gets some appreciation and credit for his work.

videos.title: Johnny Be Gone
videos.overview: Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint when Bud and Kelly run into a problem. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for some executive big-shots.

videos.title: Poppy's by the Tree (1)
videos.overview: In the second season opener, the Bundys go to a sleazy, dumpy motel in Dumpwater Florida. Trouble head their way when an axe murderer, who hates tourists, arrives.

videos.title: Poppy's by the Tree (2)
videos.overview: Peg is kidnapped by the axe murderer and it's up to Al to save her.

videos.title: If I Were a Rich Man
videos.overview: Al and Steve visit the vault at Steve's bank and the next day, one million dollars is reported missing. Peg and the kids hear about it and worship Al thinking that he stole the money and that they are now a wealthy family.

videos.title: Buck Can Do It
videos.overview: One of the Bundys neighbors threaten to sue when Buck the dog mates with their dog, and asks the Bundys to neuter Buck, which Al refuses to do.

videos.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun (1)
videos.overview: Marcy and Steve have a fight, which leads to Marcy joining Peggy and her friends going to a strip club, where Marcy accidentally loses her wedding ring ... down a stripper's pants.

videos.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun (2)
videos.overview: A stripper shows up at Al's with Marcy's wedding ring. Al convinces Steve to make Marcy feel guilty about losing it, and confronts Peg about what she was doing at the strip club.

videos.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
videos.overview: The phone company cuts off the phone service to the Bundy household after Al refuses to pay for a phone call he did not make. This annoys Peggy, Kelly, and the rest of the neighborhood.

videos.title: Born to Walk
videos.overview: Al fails his test for renewing his license on the same day Kelly gets hers.

videos.title: Alley of the Dolls
videos.overview: Peg meets and old rival from high school and their two families face off at a bowling match to see who the real loser is. With the Bundy team being one player short, Steve has to step in to help.

videos.title: The Razor's Edge
videos.overview: A fight with Marcy about his newly grown beard makes Steve spend a few nights at the Bundy household, which everyone is happy about, except Peggy and Marcy.

videos.title: How Do You Spell Revenge?
videos.overview: Al tries to improve Peg's softball skills while Kelly's boyfriend asks her to prove her love to him by getting a tattoo.

videos.title: Earth Angel
videos.overview: Bud meets a 21 year old art student in the park and brings her to the Bundy household. Everybody seems to like her but Marcy, who plans to get rid of her.

videos.title: You Better Watch Out
videos.overview: This Christmas episode tells about Santa Claus, who is late showing up at the mall. His parachute doesn't open up and he falls off his sleigh and onto the Bundy property ... dead.

videos.title: Guys and Dolls
videos.overview: Al and Steve have to go out to the streets looking for Marcy's old Barbie doll, that they traded for two rare baseball cards, not knowing that Marcy wanted to keep the doll.

videos.title: Build a Better Mousetrap
videos.overview: A mouse finds its way into the Bundy home. Too manly and proud to hire an exterminator, Al sets on killing the mouse, even if it means he has to tear the house down and damage it to shreds.

videos.title: Master the Possibilities
videos.overview: When the mailman delivers a credit card pre-approved for Buck the Dog, the Bundys go on a spending spree.

videos.title: Peggy Loves Al, Yeah Yeah, Yeah
videos.overview: On Valentines day, Bud awaits his first valentine, Kelly has a load of valentines to choose from, Steve plans on taking Marcy to Hawaii, and Peg wants Al to say "I love you" to her.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: The Bundy home is fumigated for termites, forcing the family to spend the night in the shoe store, where a grounded Kelly tends to sneak out to get to a rock concert.

videos.title: Impo-Dent
videos.overview: Marcy dents Steve's new Mercedes and heavily regrets it. Revenge brings Steve to claim she made him impotent and he uses her as his personal servant.

videos.title: Just Married... With Children
videos.overview: Having filled in an application for the Rhoades' to be on a game show, Al and Peg appear on the game show for newlyweds - "How Do I Love Thee", portraying Steve and Marcy.

videos.title: Father Lode
videos.overview: Al tries to keep his race track winnings a secret, while Peg starts taking money from Al's wallet.

videos.title: All in the Family
videos.overview: Peg's hillbilly relatives from W* County pay a visit. Fighting uncles, singing triplet aunts, whose showbiz career is threatened by Al's inputs, and Al is trying all he can to watch the John Wayne film "Hondo."

videos.title: He Thought He Could
videos.overview: In the third season opener, Al learns that he has had a copy of "The Little Engine That Could" since 1957 and when he goes to return it, he finds the same fat librarian that was there in 1957.

videos.title: I'm Going to Sweatland
videos.overview: Peg thinks she might have seen Elvis at the mall and Marcy notices a pit stain shaped like him on Al's shirt. Elvis fans come flocking around just to see it.

videos.title: Poke High
videos.overview: A high school football player is threatening to break the record Al set for Polk High.

videos.title: The Camping Show
videos.overview: A nice weekend away for the Rhoades' and the Bundys turns into misery when Peg, Kelly and Marcy all have their period at the same time, torturing the men.

videos.title: A Dump of My Own
videos.overview: Al plans on building his dream - an executive's type of bathroom in the garage.

videos.title: Her Cups Runneth Over
videos.overview: Al and Steve head off to a fancy boutique to get Peggy a new bra for her birthday.

videos.title: The Bald and the Beautiful
videos.overview: Steve fears he is losing his hair, and convinces Al that the same thing is happening to him.

videos.title: The Gypsy Cried
videos.overview: When a psychic's predictions all come true for Al, Peggy and Steve, Marcy fears that what the psychic told her will come true - her death.

videos.title: Requiem for a Dead Barber
videos.overview: Al grows his hair when his barber dies, and fears he is turning into a "sissy" just because he has to go to salons.

videos.title: Eatin' Out
videos.overview: The Bundys inherit some money from a relative and decides to go to a fancy restaurant, but Al accidentally forgets his wallet. It is up to Bud and Kelly to go back and get the wallet, but they decide to ditch their parents at the restaurant, unable to pay the bill.

videos.title: My Mom, the Mom
videos.overview: Peg goes to Kelly's school for mother-daughter day and talks about the joy of being a housewife, meanwhile Bud has to learn the value of a dollar after breaking the Rhoades' window.

videos.title: Can't Dance, Don't Ask Me
videos.overview: Kelly has to tap dance at a dance recital because of a prank she pulled.

videos.title: A Three Job, No Income Family
videos.overview: Al gets a second job in an attempt to make more money than Peg after she starts earning money selling 'Patty Girl' cosmetics.

videos.title: The Harder They Fall
videos.overview: Steve gives a driver "the finger" and fears that the man will beat him up.

videos.title: The House That Peg Lost
videos.overview: Steve and Marcy ask Peggy to look over their house, but when a moving company asks for "Steves Roadhouse", Peggy allows the company to tow away the Rhoades' home, and they have to spend a night at the Bundys - where Kelly is having a slumber party.

videos.title: Married... with Prom Queen (1)
videos.overview: Al and Peggy go to their high school reunion. Peggy wants to be prom queen and she spent a lot of money calling old friends and buying new clothes to gain votes. But when she thinks she has the majority of the votes, her rival Connie Bender appears and surprises Peg with the fact that Connie is now in the lead to be prom queen.

videos.title: Married... with Prom Queen: The Sequel (2)
videos.overview: Peggy tries desperately to get more votes but it seems that most of the people are going to vote for Connie. Bud and Kelly ask Marcy and Steve about the sixties and after some history, Bud and Kelly dress up as hippies and visit the prom. Al runs into his old rival Jack, who appears to be Connie's husband, and Al and Jack decides to fight outside. Meanwhile, Peg rigs the election ... will she win?

videos.title: The Dateless Amigo
videos.overview: Bud tries to find a girl who will date him when both of his friends have dates.

videos.title: The Computer Show
videos.overview: Steve and Marcy convince Peggy to buy a computer for the family, but nobody uses it.

videos.title: Life's a Beach
videos.overview: When the family visit the beach, Al meets an ex-girlfriend and Bud and Kelly both look for dates.

videos.title: Here's Lookin' at You, Kid
videos.overview: When all the women in the neighborhood gets peeped on except Peggy, she gets really jealous and eventually puts out a ladder, milk, and cookies for the him. Meanwhile Al convinces Bud to stop fooling Kelly and actually help her with her studies.

videos.title: Hot off the Grill
videos.overview: Marcy's dead aunt's ashes end up in the Labor Day hamburgers.

videos.title: Dead Men Don't Do Aerobics
videos.overview: Peggy wins a free health week with the healthiest man in Chicago, but ends up converting him to her lifestyle, and he drops dead.

videos.title: Buck Saves the Day
videos.overview: Kelly and Bud try to raise money to got to a concert. Kelly's scheme involves playing poker against Peggy's friends and Bud makes Al take a bunch of kids camping.

videos.title: Tooth or Consequences
videos.overview: Al goes to Marcy's dentist and finds that he has a relationship with his assistant.

videos.title: He Ain't Much, but He's Mine
videos.overview: Peggy talks to a woman at a beauty parlor, and becomes convinced that Al is cheating on her, with that woman.

videos.title: Fair Exchange
videos.overview: The Bundys lets a foreign exchange student live in their home for the weekly $500 that the government will pay them, but the french girl ends up ruining Kelly's social life.

videos.title: Desperately Seeking Miss October
videos.overview: A Playboy model visits the shoe store and Al wants to find out which issue she is in, but Peggy sold his Playboy collection and Al has to convince her to get the magazines back.

videos.title: 976-SHOE
videos.overview: Steve risks his job when Al takes a $50,000 loan from Steve's bank to start a shoe hotline.

videos.title: Oh, What a Feeling
videos.overview: Al decides to get a new car, but finds out that Peggy spent all his saved up money, and he has to buy an old, used car.

videos.title: At the Zoo
videos.overview: Steve spends time at the zoo with the Bundys instead of looking for a job, which upsets Marcy.

videos.title: It's a Bundyful Life (1)
videos.overview: Al has finally saved up enough money to buy Christmas gifts for everyone, but a few late customers to the shoe store makes Al unable to get to the bank.

videos.title: It's a Bundyful Life (2)
videos.overview: Al gets a visit from a guardian angel and discovers what the Bundy household would look like if he was never born.

videos.title: Who'll Stop the Rain
videos.overview: Al's pride and "do-it-yourself" beliefs annoys the rest of the family when Al decides to fix the leaking roof himself.

videos.title: A Taxing Problem
videos.overview: After Peggy lied on the Bundy taxes, Al has to find a quick way to raise money for the audit, and when a couple offers good money for Peggy's hair, Al must find a way to convince her.

videos.title: Rock and Roll Girl
videos.overview: Kelly becomes a rock and roll singer with Bud as her agent.

videos.title: You Gotta Know When to Fold 'Em (1)
videos.overview: Peggy takes Marcy on a trip to Las Vegas to get over her divorce from Steve.

videos.title: You Gotta Know When to Fold 'Em (2)
videos.overview: Al, Bud and Kelly arrive in Las Vegas to find Peg and Marcy completely broke, and they must find a way to raise some money to get back home.

videos.title: What Goes Around Came Around
videos.overview: Bud tries to get revenge on a girl who humiliated him years ago.

videos.title: Peggy Turns 300
videos.overview: Al plans a special evening for Peggy's birthday by taking her out to the Bowlarama where he hopes to finally beat his arch rival's high game score. Al beats the score, but minutes later, Peggy bowls a perfect game, destroying Al's self-esteem.

videos.title: Peggy Made a Little Lamb
videos.overview: Peggy must repeat Home Ec class to get her high school diploma.

videos.title: Rain Girl
videos.overview: Kelly gets a new job as a weather girl at a local news station.

videos.title: The Agony of De-Feet
videos.overview: Al has to judge a beauty contest at the shoe store and has nightmares about feet. Meanwhile, Kelly tricks Bud and Marcy into thinking they slept with each other.

videos.title: Yard Sale
videos.overview: After discovering Peggy's latest purchases, Al throws a yard sale to get rid of a lot of the junk, but no one is interested.

videos.title: We'll Follow the Sun
videos.overview: The Bundys get stuck in traffic on Labor Day.

videos.title: Al... with Kelly
videos.overview: Al and Kelly pretend to be sick so they can avoid going with Peggy and Bud to Wanker County, but Kelly ends up really getting sick and Al has to care for her for the entire week which interrupts Al's fantasies of being with two beautiful women.

videos.title: Sue Casa, His Casa
videos.overview: After Al decides he doesn't need insurance, Bud gets in an accident and they counter sue the other driver with Marcy as a witness.

videos.title: The Unnatural
videos.overview: Al's softball team wants to bench him before the big championship, but Peggy, Kelly and Bud hold three of the required votes to omit him. Peggy is swayed by the hunk who will replace Al, while it takes food to get the kids' votes.

videos.title: The Dance Show
videos.overview: Al doesn't mind Peggy going out with Marcy every night to a ballroom dance hall and dance the night away with a handsome man named Andy, until another man, named Pete, tells Al that Peggy is stealing someone's husband - his.

videos.title: Kelly Bounces Back
videos.overview: Kelly auditions for a job as a spokesperson for the new Allante car.

videos.title: Married... with Aliens
videos.overview: Al gets a visit from small green aliens who steal his socks.

videos.title: Wabbit Season
videos.overview: A rabbit destroys Al's fantasy of having a vegetable garden.

videos.title: Do Ya Think I'm Sexy
videos.overview: Al become the neighborhood stud when some women see him move a couch.

videos.title: One Down, Two to Go
videos.overview: Kelly moves out after Al beats up yet another of her boyfriends. This upsets Peggy, who becomes an overprotective mom, to Bud's dislike.

videos.title: And Baby Makes Money
videos.overview: Al and Peggy try to have another baby after a dead relative promised $500,000 to the couple who provide an heir named after him.

videos.title: Married... with Who
videos.overview: Marcy wakes up after a drunken night and finds herself married to Jefferson.

videos.title: The Godfather
videos.overview: Al becomes the neighborhood godfather when Kelly starts dating a 41-year-old man with the right connections.

videos.title: Look Who's Barking
videos.overview: Buck brings a female dog into the house, and feels neglected when the family only care about the new dog.

videos.title: A Man's Castle
videos.overview: Al is horrified when Peggy completely redecorates his bathroom, turning it pink.

videos.title: All Night Security Dude
videos.overview: Al gets a job as a security guard at Polk High, but gets fired after the championship trophy is stolen by Al's old nemesis.

videos.title: Oldies but Young 'Uns
videos.overview: Al goes crazy trying to remember the name of a song he heard on the radio.

videos.title: Weenie Tot Lovers & Other Strangers
videos.overview: Al has to choose whether to spend his money on Bud's visit to the White House or letting Kelly enter a Miss Weenie Tot contest.

videos.title: Kids! Wadaya Gonna Do?
videos.overview: Al and Peggy take over Marcy's house when they go to watch a movie there. Meanwhile, Bud takes a girl to a concert and Kelly babysits a lot of horrible children.

videos.title: Top of the Heap
videos.overview: In a spinoff attempt of Married ... with Children, we follow the lives of Charlie and Vinnie Verducci. Charlie wants Vinnie to marry rich to get a better life and they go to a formal fund raiser to meet rich women.

videos.title: You Better Shop Around (1)
videos.overview: Al buys a cheap old air conditioner which leads to a massive blackout in the entire neighborhood, forcing the Bundy's to move into a supermarket.

videos.title: You Better Shop Around (2)
videos.overview: The Bundys and the D'Arcys face off to see who can spend the $1,000 shopping spree first. Meanwhile, Bud and Kelly bother celebrity Jerry Mathers who judges the contest.

videos.title: Route 666 (1)
videos.overview: The Bundy car breaks down in New Mexico and they have to call Marcy and Jefferson for help.

videos.title: Route 666 (2)
videos.overview: The Bundys and the D'Arcys face the effects of greed as they discover a gold mine in the desert.

videos.title: Buck the Stud
videos.overview: A man offers the Bundys $10,000 if they allow Buck to breed with his dog.

videos.title: She's Having My Baby (1)
videos.overview: Marcy and Peggy discover they are both pregnant, to Jefferson's joy and Al's horror.

videos.title: She's Having My Baby (2)
videos.overview: Al runs off to a bus station to escape Peggy's constant demands, and Jefferson does the same by running away from Marcy.

videos.title: If Al Had a Hammer
videos.overview: Al builds a private room for himself, using the Bundy hammer.  Meanwhile, Bud starts going by "Grandmaster B," but nobody can remember his nickname right.

videos.title: Cheese, Cues and Blood
videos.overview: In order to earn money for a competition, Kelly hustle men for money by playing pool.

videos.title: Looking for a Desk in All the Wrong Places
videos.overview: Peggy and Marcy go out on a journey to buy back all of Marcy's childhood furniture, which Jefferson sold.

videos.title: Buck Has a Belly Ache
videos.overview: Peggy gets jealous of Buck when the family pay him all the attention, and she flees home to W* County.

videos.title: If I Could See Me Now
videos.overview: Bud and Kelly convince Al to get glasses after a few minor  accidents.

videos.title: God's Shoes
videos.overview: After having a vision of God, Al starts building the perfect shoes.

videos.title: Kelly Does Hollywood (1)
videos.overview: Kelly gets her own talk show and the other networks become interested in it.

videos.title: Kelly Does Hollywood (2)
videos.overview: Kelly goes to Hollywood, but her show gets slaughtered by the censors.

videos.title: Al Bundy, Shoe Dick
videos.overview: Al gets a job as a private detective and is framed for murder.

videos.title: So This Is How Sinatra Felt
videos.overview: Peggy thinks Al is having an affair, so she sends the kids to spy on him.

videos.title: I Who Have Nothing
videos.overview: Al discovers that he truly has no possessions of his own, and decides to get back one of the things that truly meant a lot to him - his championship game ball.

videos.title: The Mystery of Skull Island
videos.overview: Bud dates an extreme sporter and the D'Arcys play a relationship board game with Peggy and Al.

videos.title: Just Shoe It
videos.overview: Al gets to star in an athletic shoe commericial.

videos.title: Rites of Passage
videos.overview: In traditional male Bundy bonding, Al takes Bud to the nudie bar on his 18th birthday.

videos.title: The Egg and I
videos.overview: Steve Rhoades returns to reclaim his wife, but is shocked to find out that Marcy remarried. The Bundys argue whether friendship is more important than money when they find out that Steve is on the run from the police for stealing a rare egg from a national park.

videos.title: My Dinner With Anthrax
videos.overview: Bud wins a ""Dinner with Anthrax"" contest and sends away Al and Peg on a timeshare vacation to Florida while Anthrax visit the house.

videos.title: Psychic Avengers
videos.overview: Jefferson lets Al in on his psychic phone scam but the Bundys soon take over the business.

videos.title: Hi I.Q.
videos.overview: Bud is suspicious when Kelly is invited to a party for smart people.

videos.title: Teacher Pets
videos.overview: Bud juggles two women at once, one being Miss McGowen, his English teacher. Meanwhile, the family ignores Peggy when she is sick and Al gets free pizza by attending children's birthday parties at Chuck E. Cheese.

videos.title: The Goodbye Girl
videos.overview: Kelly gets a job at an amusement park. Meanwhile, Al takes a personal vacation - in the Bundy living room.

videos.title: The Gas Station Show
videos.overview: Al must work at a gas station after Peggy and the kids buy too much junk food, which Al cannot pay for, so he has to work off his debt.

videos.title: England Show (1)
videos.overview: The Bundys win a free trip to England, but the villagers of Lower Uncton, England, want to get rid of all male Bundys in the world to break a curse cast upon their village.

videos.title: England Show (2)
videos.overview: The Bundys spend a day shopping in England before finally going to Lower Uncton, not knowing what awaits them.

videos.title: England Show (3)
videos.overview: Al has to joust for his and his family's life in a medieval tournament in Lower Uncton.

videos.title: Magnificent Seven
videos.overview: Al is shocked about having another kid when Peggy's relatives leave their five-year-old son Seven in the Bundy home.

videos.title: T-R-A-Something-Something Spells Tramp
videos.overview: Kelly has to walk through the wilderness after dumping her boyfriend in the forest. Al and Peg try to talk their marriage alive, but without success. Bud dates a girl with the measles.

videos.title: Every Bundy Has a Birthday
videos.overview: Peggy discovers that Seven does not know when his birthday is, and the family decides to celebrate him... on Al's birthday.

videos.title: Al on the Rocks
videos.overview: Al has to take a job as a topless bartender to pay for Seven's doctor bill, but Peggy fears that Bud and Kelly might make Seven sick, and kicks them out of the house.

videos.title: What I Did for Love
videos.overview: Peggy tries to make Al more interested in having sex with her by purchasing new dresses, unsucessfully.

videos.title: Frat Chance
videos.overview: Bud starts his own fraternity to get women.

videos.title: The Chicago Wine Party
videos.overview: The Bundys vote against a two cent beer tax.

videos.title: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
videos.overview: Al makes Kelly get a job, so she becomes a waitress.

videos.title: Rock of Ages
videos.overview: Al and the family try to sneak into the first class lounge by dressing up like rock stars.

videos.title: Death of a Shoe Salesman
videos.overview: Al buys a cemetery plot so that he will be buried next to a western movie star and a mule. But Peggy feels excluded.

videos.title: The Old College Try
videos.overview: Bud gets a huge money grant to go to college, but Al and Peggy spend it all on items for themselves.

videos.title: Christmas
videos.overview: Al remembers how the Bundys celebrated Christmas over the years.

videos.title: Wedding Show
videos.overview: Al becomes frustrated when Peggy can't decide what to wear to a family wedding.  Meanwhile, Bud gets to know the bride and Kelly spends time with the bridesmaids.

videos.title: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This
videos.overview: Peggy and Marcy ruin Al's fishing trip by constantly fighting.  Meanwhile, Jefferson and the kids spend Marcy's money.

videos.title: Heels on Wheels
videos.overview: Kelly buys a motorcycle, which upsets the rest of the family who find it unsafe.

videos.title: Mr. Empty Pants
videos.overview: Peggy creates a cartoon character named Mr. Empty Pants, who bears a strange resemblance to Al.

videos.title: You Can't Miss
videos.overview: Bud appears on a game show for single men.  Meanwhile, Al and Peg don't sleep for days and Kelly fears that there is a conspiracy against her.

videos.title: Peggy and the Pirates
videos.overview: Peggy tells Seven a fantasy store about pirates and beautiful princesses.

videos.title: Go for the Old
videos.overview: Al competes in an athletic championship for seniors.
